targetTexts.1: A wise son heeds his father’s discipline, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.
targetTexts.2: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things, but the desire of the faithless is violence.
targetTexts.3: He who guards his mouth protects his life, but the one who opens his lips invites his own ruin.
targetTexts.4: The slacker craves yet has nothing, but the soul of the diligent is fully satisfied.
targetTexts.5: The righteous hate falsehood, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.
targetTexts.6: Righteousness guards the man of integrity, but wickedness undermines the sinner.
targetTexts.7: One pretends to be rich, but has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.
targetTexts.8: Riches may ransom a man’s life, but a poor man hears no threat.
targetTexts.9: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.
targetTexts.10: Arrogance leads only to strife, but wisdom is with the well-advised.
targetTexts.11: Dishonest wealth will dwindle, but what is earned through hard work will be multiplied.
targetTexts.12: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
targetTexts.13: He who despises instruction will pay the penalty, but the one who respects a command will be rewarded.
targetTexts.14: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning one from the snares of death.
targetTexts.15: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the faithless is difficult.
targetTexts.16: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, but a fool displays his folly.
targetTexts.17: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings healing.
targetTexts.18: Poverty and shame come to him who ignores discipline, but whoever heeds correction is honored.
targetTexts.19: Desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but turning from evil is detestable to fools.
targetTexts.20: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
targetTexts.21: Disaster pursues sinners, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.
targetTexts.22: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the sinner’s wealth is passed to the righteous.
targetTexts.23: Abundant food is in the fallow ground of the poor, but without justice it is swept away.
targetTexts.24: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him disciplines him diligently.
targetTexts.25: A righteous man eats to his heart’s content, but the stomach of the wicked is empty.
